sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The drifting things reach you, and they do not swing for your body. One presses a cold hand to a face and reaches inside, dredging up something buried. The other simply passes through a body like a door, and for a horrible moment a soul stands outside itself, unable to move, unable to act, while the fight roars on without them. These are worse than the dead. These ask questions you do not want to answer.

Publicobjective: Survive the wraiths, protect each other, and keep the ritual on track.

Readaloud: The drifting things reach you, and they do not swing for your body. One presses a cold hand to a face and reaches inside, dredging up something buried. The other simply passes through a body like a door, and for a horrible moment a soul stands outside itself, unable to move, unable to act, while the fight roars on without them. These are worse than the dead. These ask questions you do not want to answer.
Gmnotes: Use Pass-Through sparingly. Rescue and grounding should return players to action quickly.
Gmscript: Say: "These do not want your blood. They want your worst memory and your soul out of your body. If someone gets knocked loose, protecting and calling them back is the scene."
Gmreadaloud: The drifting things reach you. They do not swing for your body. A cold hand reaches inside memory. A soul can stand outside itself for one horrible moment.

Gmchecklist: Use Soul-Audit Wraith stats: Difficulty 13, HP 6, Stress 3, ATK +3, Lifedrain Far 2d6+8 magic. Physical resistance halves incoming physical damage, round up. Memory Delve: Close attack; ask for a terrifying childhood moment, then 3d4+9 magic and Vulnerable until next rest. Pass-Through: spend Fear, Melee attack; on hit target is Untethered until countdown ticks down. Whole party Untethered at once: all mark 2 HP, souls return, condition clears. Track protected_whom as the primary emotional write.
Gmprivate: Memory Delve hooks live in perCharacterLayer. Use the active PC's hook if helpful, but accept any player-safe version. Soul-economy stays a seed. The word itself is GM-only.
Playertakeaway: You cannot out-muscle these; protect each other, cover the Untethered, and endure.
Storytakeaway: The wraiths attack who you are, not just what you can take.
Mechanictakeaway: Memory Delve, Vulnerable, Pass-Through, Untethered, and grounding an ally make care a live combat mechanic.

Storyscope: Perceived antagonist: the forest. True antagonist: the corporate lie about the forest. The players never confront it directly. They are meant to feel it by the end. Every act offers at least one guaranteed and one earned hint that the danger is manufactured and the forest is not the enemy. Soul-Audit Wraiths bear audit glyphs and say, "Unlicensed soul-resonance detected. Submit for audit."
